note: Re-judged 2026-11-27 independently against RFC 3748 Section 7.10 (rfc/full/rfc3748.txt): "an EAP method supporting key derivation MUST export a Master Session Key (MSK) of at least 64 octets, and an Extended Master Session Key (EMSK) of at least 64 octets." TestRFC3748NoEMSKWithoutACompletedExport and emskExchange added matching ServerIdentity="eap-tls-server" (with AllowedIdentities=["eap-tls-client"] on serverConfig). Positive units still assert exact 64-octet MSK and EMSK derivation matching the TLS 1.2/1.3 export on EAP-TLS and HKDF/RFC 3079 on MS-CHAPv2; negative units still assert zero EMSK/MSK on untrusted-CA refusal and on refused TLS 1.2 export. Verdict stands: enforced.
